description: This file defines the PackagesChangedReceiver class, a BroadcastReceiver that listens for package-related system broadcasts such as package added, removed, changed, or replaced, and executes a callback when such events occur.

classes.name: PackagesChangedReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that detects package changes and triggers a callback.

methods.name: PackagesChangedReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a callback to execute upon package change events.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents related to package changes and logs the event.

methods.name: createIntentFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns an IntentFilter configured to listen for package change related actions.
